THE HOME DEPOT, INC. (HD) REPORT OVERVIEW
The Home Depot's Recent Financial Performance
For the three months ended July 31st, 2018 vs July 31st, 2017, The Home Depot reported revenue of $30,463.00MM vs $28,108.00MM (up 8.38%) and analysts estimated basic earnings per share $3.06 vs $2.26 (up 35.40%). For the twelve months ended January 31st, 2018 vs January 31st, 2017, The Home Depot reported revenue of $100,904.00MM vs $94,595.00MM (up 6.67%) and analysts estimated basic earnings per share $7.33 vs $6.47 (up 13.29%). Analysts expect earnings to be released on November 13th, 2018. The report will be for the fiscal period ending October 31st, 2018. Based on 14 analysts' forecasts, the consensus EPS forecast for the quarter is $2.84. The reported EPS for the same quarter last year was $1.84. The estimated EPS forecast for the next fiscal year is $10.24 and is expected to report on February 19th, 2019.
